project.name: Trendyol Marketplace Integration
project.description: Integrate Trendyol marketplace into the existing shipping and order sync platform using a minimal-impact, feature-flagged approach.

master.name: master
master.description: Main development context for Trendyol integration

master.title: Snapshot & Feature Flag
master.description: Freeze current working app and create a reversible feature flag MARKETPLACE_TRENDYOL
master.details:
Create feature branch and implement feature flag system to enable/disable Trendyol functionality without affecting existing features. Steps:
- git checkout -b feature/trendyol
- add env flag to .env.example; default false
- wrap any new Trendyol calls behind if (process.env.MARKETPLACE_TRENDYOL === 'true')
master.testStrategy: Verify build passes; no functional change when flag is false

master.title: Audit Existing Marketplace Paths
master.description: Map how shippo/veeqo flows traverse the codebase so we can piggy-back on existing patterns
master.details:
Analyze current marketplace integration patterns to understand the flow from request to service to database to UI. Steps:
- search marketplace enum usages in /lib /pages/api /prisma
- list shared service helpers (e.g. order sync, label creation)
- output a diagram of request → service → db → UI for one existing marketplace

master.title: SDK & Auth Layer
master.description: Create a thin Trendyol REST client without new external dependencies
master.details:
Build Trendyol API client with authentication. Steps:
- add lib/clients/trendyolClient.ts (axios wrapper)
- read TRENDYOL_SUPPLIER_ID, TRENDYOL_API_KEY, TRENDYOL_API_SECRET from env
- implement signed request helper similar to current Etsy OAuth util
master.testStrategy: Unit test hits /suppliers/{id}/products in sandbox mode via nock

master.title: DTO Alignment (no new tables)
master.description: Adapt Trendyol payloads to existing Order, OrderItem, ShippingAddress shapes
master.details:
Create data mappers for Trendyol API responses. Steps:
- in lib/mappers/trendyol.ts, write toOrder(), toOrderItem() converters
- map Trendyol status → existing OrderStatus enum
- store trendyolOrderNumber in Order.marketplaceOrderId string field
master.testStrategy: Mapper unit test converts sample JSON without undefined fields

master.title: Sync Command
master.details:
Add Trendyol to existing sync endpoints. Steps:
- update /api/orders/sync to accept trendyolApiKey, trendyolApiSecret, trendyolSupplierId
- ensure syncAllOrders() calls fetchTrendyolOrders() when credentials present
- test incremental sync with updatedAfter parameter
master.testStrategy: POST /api/orders/sync with Trendyol credentials returns orders

master.title: Background Job Wiring
master.description: Schedule periodic sync without new infrastructure
master.details:
Integrate with existing job queue system. Steps:
- extend existing Bull queue orderSync with type: 'trendyol'
- job processor selects the correct sync function
master.testStrategy: Dev queue dashboard shows Trendyol jobs enqueue & complete

master.title: UI Surface
master.description: Show Trendyol in filters and icons only, no new pages
master.details:
Add Trendyol to existing UI components. Steps:
- append 'Trendyol' to OrderSource enum & shared badge component
- ensure labels page renders orders when order.source === 'TRENDYOL'
master.testStrategy: UI renders new badge; other sources unchanged

master.title: Shipping Label Flow Re-use
master.description: Prepare address mapping for future shipping integrations (no labels yet)
master.details:
Validate address mapping for future Turkish cargo company integration. Steps:
- confirm address mapper populates required fields
- document shipping limitations (domestic only)
- Note: No shipping label generation for now since Trendyol requires Turkish cargo companies
master.testStrategy: Address validation unit tests pass; documentation updated

master.title: End-to-End Smoke Test
master.description: Test complete flow from API to UI with real credentials
master.details:
Validate complete Trendyol integration flow. Steps:
- test with real Trendyol API credentials
- verify orders appear in UI with correct marketplace badge
- confirm sync works with feature flag enabled/disabled
- test incremental sync with updatedAfter parameter
- Added Trendyol credential fields to settings page (/ayarlar)
- Updated API endpoint to handle Trendyol credentials
master.testStrategy: Real API test passes; orders display correctly in UI; settings page allows credential entry

master.title: Rollout & Monitoring
master.description: Deploy safely with gradual user rollout
master.details:
Safe production deployment. Steps:
- deploy flag default off → production
- enable for internal user id list via ALLOW_TRENDYOL_USERS env
- add Sentry breadcrumb in trendyolClient for error tracking

master.title: Documentation & Support
master.details:
Complete documentation. Steps:
- README marketplace table: add Trendyol ✔ order sync, ✔ future label support
- write onboarding guide: how to obtain API keys
- document shipping limitations (domestic only, Turkish cargo companies planned)
